basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graduate student currently pursuing a Master's in Mathematics at Cambridge University. Originally from a small town in the UK, I moved to Cambridge for my studies. I love playing The Sims 4 and often indulge in buying expansion packs, especially after a glass or two of wine. I'm a vegetarian and enjoy cooking new plant-based recipes. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes or late at night when I'm unwinding. In a relationship, but we keep our finances separate. I love music and am part of a band called 'Maniac' that performs locally.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in mathematics, acquired through my formal education at Cambridge University. I am also self-taught in the nuances of gaming and vegetarian cooking through online communities and personal experimentation.
